federation.settings.title: Fediverse
federation.settings.description: Let people on Mastodon and other fediverse servers follow your channel from their own accounts.
federation.settings.loadFailed: Your federation settings didn't load. Refresh the page to retry.
federation.settings.enabled: Publish this channel to the fediverse
federation.settings.turnedOn: Your channel now publishes to the fediverse.
federation.settings.turnedOff: Your channel no longer publishes to the fediverse.
federation.settings.saveFailed: Federation could not be changed. Try again.
federation.settings.offBody: Remote servers are asked to delete your profile and posts, but they may or may not do so. Your remote followers are lost: if you turn this back on, they have to follow you again.
federation.settings.handleCopyFailed: The handle could not be copied. Select it and copy it instead.
federation.settings.handleHint: People search for this handle on their own server to follow you.
federation.notes.title: What this does
federation.notes.posted: A post goes out to your fediverse followers when you go live, and when a video or clip becomes public. Posts link back here; the video itself is not copied.
federation.notes.mature: If your channel is marked mature, posts carry a content warning and no images.
federation.notes.replies: Replies, likes and boosts on other servers are not read and never shown here.
federation.notes.delete: Turning this off, or a suspension, asks remote servers to delete your profile and posts. They may or may not do so: copies on other servers cannot be forced away.
federation.notes.refollow: Remote followers lost that way have to follow you again.
federation.followers.title: Remote followers
federation.followers.intro: Shown as text only: nothing is loaded from their servers.
federation.followers.loadFailed: Your remote followers didn't load. Refresh the page to retry.
federation.followers.loadMoreFailed: More followers didn't load. Try again.
federation.followers.emptyHint: People on other servers can follow {handle}.
federation.followers.emptyHintOff: Turn federation on to let people on other servers follow you.
federation.followers.removeBody: {handle} stops receiving your posts. They can follow you again later.
federation.followers.removeFailed: The follower could not be removed. Try again.
federation.admin.title: Federation
federation.admin.intro: Which fediverse servers this instance talks to, and the keys channels sign their posts with.
federation.admin.offTitle: Federation is off on this instance
federation.admin.offBody: Channels cannot publish to the fediverse, and nothing is sent to or accepted from other servers.
federation.admin.offHowTo: To turn it on, set this in the instance environment and restart the API and the worker:
federation.admin.offThen: Each channel stays off until its owner turns federation on in their stream settings.
federation.blocks.title: Blocked domains
federation.blocks.intro: A blocked server's requests are refused, its followers are dropped and nothing is delivered to it.
federation.blocks.subdomains: A block covers the domain and all of its subdomains: blocking example.social also blocks media.example.social.
federation.blocks.addFailed: The domain could not be blocked. Try again.
federation.blocks.addBody: Servers at {domain} and its subdomains can no longer follow channels here, and their followers are dropped now. Unblocking later does not bring those followers back.
federation.blocks.invalid: Enter a domain name, such as example.social.
federation.blocks.covered: {domain} is already blocked by the block on {parent}.
federation.blocks.loadFailed: The blocked domains didn't load. Refresh the page to retry.
federation.blocks.emptyHint: Every fediverse server may follow channels here.
federation.blocks.removeBody: Its servers may follow channels here again. Followers dropped by the block do not come back on their own.
federation.blocks.removeFailed: The domain could not be unblocked. Try again.
federation.keys.title: Signing keys
federation.keys.intro: Each federated channel signs its posts with its own key. Keys rotate yearly on their own; rotate them all now if you think a key has leaked.
federation.keys.confirmBody: Every federated channel gets a new key now, and its followers' servers are sent the new key. A few deliveries may be refused until they have it.
federation.keys.rotated: {count, plural, =0 {No keys to rotate.} one {# key rotated.} other {# keys rotated.}}
federation.keys.rotateFailed: The keys could not be rotated. Try again.
